See ST Waterfall Plots for details of analysis methods.


```{r,echo=FALSE}
source('../R/WaterfallPlot.R')
```

# Trial Detail

```{r}
iowa <- read.csv("./IowaOnFarmTrials.csv",header=TRUE)
idx <- which(names(iowa)=='Avg..Yield.Difference.bu.acre')
names(iowa)[idx] <- 'Difference'

trial.counts <- tapply(iowa$Difference,iowa$Trial.Detail,length)
ordered <- trial.counts[order(trial.counts,decreasing=TRUE)]
ordered[1:10]
```

```{r}
type.counts <- tapply(iowa$Difference,iowa$Trial.Type,length)
type.ordered <- type.counts[order(type.counts,decreasing=TRUE)]
type.ordered[1:10]
```



## Headline

```{r}
Headline <- iowa[iowa$Trial.Detail==names(ordered)[1],]
```


```{r,fig.width=12,fig.height=5}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
WaterfallPlot(Headline$Difference,error='nonpar',basis='Difference')
WaterfallPlot(Headline$Difference, error='ecdf',basis='Difference')
```

```{r,fig.width=12,fig.height=7}
WaterfallPlot(Headline$Difference,error='nonpar',basis='Difference',Groups=Headline$Crop)
WaterfallPlot(Headline$Difference, error='nonpar',basis='Difference',Groups=Headline$Year)
WaterfallPlot(Headline$Difference, error='nonpar',basis='Difference',Groups=Headline$Landform.Region)
WaterfallPlot(Headline$Difference, error='nonpar',basis='Difference',Groups=Headline$Crop.District)
```

```{r}
#hist(Headline$Difference)
#qqnorm(Headline$Difference)
plot(ecdf(Headline$Difference))
```

## Stratego YLD vs Untreated and        Stratego vs Untreated 

```{r,fig.width=12,fig.height=5}

StrategoYLD <- iowa[iowa$Trial.Detail==names(ordered)[5],]
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
WaterfallPlot(Stratego$Difference,error='nonpar',basis='Difference')
WaterfallPlot(StrategoYLD$Difference, error='nonpar',basis='Difference')
```

```{r,fig.width=12,fig.height=5}
Stratego <- iowa[iowa$Trial.Detail==names(ordered)[5] | iowa$Trial.Detail==names(ordered)[6],]
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
WaterfallPlot(Stratego$Difference,error='nonpar',basis='Difference')
WaterfallPlot(Stratego$Difference, error='normal',basis='Difference')
```

```{r,fig.width=12,fig.height=7}

```

# Trial Type

